prototype_strategy: One modular shared physical prototype; specialized capabilities phased
accounting_policy: Subsystem allocations are envelopes, not spending. Charge each physical component once; cross-reference requirement IDs. Quoted costs require vendor/date; purchases require invoice evidence.
notes: Previous MOB-001..010 estimates are provisional and must be reconciled against these allocations; never added again.
Full-size autonomy, 230V tether and safety certification not funded/validated by this initial prototype envelope.

MOB-011: optional future load cell + HX711 and mounting/calibration estimated ₹500–₹1,100; unquoted, unpurchased, must be accommodated within existing controller/sensors and fabrication envelopes. Current software incremental purchase cost ₹0.
